stories.title: Suno is trying to look more like a real music production tool
stories.simple_summary: Suno, which is an AI tool that creates music, is adding professional features like MIDI support so it works more like real music production software that musicians use.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're a musician or small music business, this could eventually make AI music tools more useful for your actual work — but it's still mainly for people who work with music regularly.

stories.title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft is combining its different AI assistant apps into one and shutting down some features that didn't work well, like AI-generated podcasts.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Microsoft's Copilot (their AI helper), you'll have one app instead of several — simpler for you, but nothing urgent to worry about.

stories.title: I looked inside an AI generated movie, and the best parts were all human
stories.simple_summary: A movie was made partly with AI, and the review found that the human-made parts were noticeably better than the AI-generated parts.
stories.why_it_matters: This honestly doesn't affect you — it's mostly interesting to people in the movie business.

stories.title: Nvidia’s new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia, the company that makes computer chips for AI, has a plan to keep its old chips valuable by getting companies to keep buying and using them.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and big companies — nothing you need to think about for your business.

stories.title: Apple in talks to pay publishers to provide Siri with current news: report
stories.simple_summary: Apple is talking to news publishers about paying them money so that Siri (Apple's voice helper) can give you current news.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Siri on an Apple phone, you might eventually get better, up-to-date news answers — but this is still in early talks.

stories.title: Does Google even want to win at AI?
stories.simple_summary: Google announced changes to how it's organizing its AI division, and people are wondering if Google is keeping up with the competition.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly about how a giant tech company is organized — it doesn't change anything for your daily life.

stories.title: Microsoft is combining its Copilot apps ahead of a ‘super app’
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft is combining its personal Copilot app with its work-focused Copilot app into one single app that works for both home and business.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Microsoft Copilot at work and home, you'll have one app instead of two — convenient if you use it, but most small-business owners won't be affected.

stories.title: Some Claude users are mad that Anthropic’s new watermarks will catch them using it at their jobs, classes
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic (a company that makes Claude, an AI assistant) is adding watermarks to show when something was made by their AI, and some people are upset because this might reveal they're using it at work or school.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Claude and want to keep that private at work or school, this could be a concern — but most small-business owners won't be affected.

stories.title: Amazon will train on Twitch streamers’ content by default, unless they opt out
stories.simple_summary: Amazon says it will use videos from Twitch streamers (a streaming video platform) to train its AI, unless streamers specifically say no.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're a Twitch streamer, check your settings — your videos might be used for AI training unless you opt out.

stories.title: AI coding startup Cognition reportedly already in talks to raise at $40B valuation
stories.simple_summary: A startup called Cognition that makes AI coding tools is trying to raise more money at a very high value.
stories.why_it_matters: This is purely about investor deals — nothing you need to worry about.

stories.title: As AI safety concerns mount, three pioneers make the case for staying open
stories.simple_summary: Three famous AI scientists discussed whether AI tools should be freely available to everyone or more restricted, and whether the U.S. should regulate AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This is experts discussing big policy questions — nothing that affects you today, though these decisions could matter later.

stories.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raises $2B to bring AI to the enterprise
stories.simple_summary: A company called Thrive Holdings raised $2 billion in funding to build AI tools for businesses.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an investment story — nothing you need to act on right now.
